quote: both models share the same architecture, which trains a Q-former Transformer that connects a frozen vision encoder (ViT-g/14) to a frozen instruction-tuned language model (Flan-T5XXL) to output text based on an input image and text.

We present INFOSEEK, a natural VQA dataset that focuses on visual info‑seeking questions... The models directly predict the answer from looking at the image and question; ... we evaluate the generated textual answers using VQA accuracy and relaxed accuracy.
We introduced INFOSEEK, a large-scale VQA dataset that focuses on answering visual information seeking questions.
outputs: The paper generates natural language answers to visual information-seeking questions, which is a form of natural language generation in the context of multimodal question answering.

quote: Evaluation Metric. Three types of questions are evaluated differently: VQA accuracy for STRING and TIME; Relaxed Accuracy for NUMERICAL.
We adopt VQA accuracy for STRING and TIME; Relaxed Accuracy for NUMERICAL; we also compute the harmonic mean of UNSEEN QUESTION and UNSEEN ENTITY splits as the overall accuracy.

We applied different relaxing strategies for each question type, and averaged the accuracy for each question. Finally, we calculate the accuracy for each data split (UNSEEN QUESTION and UNSEEN ENTITY), and take the harmonic mean of them as the overall accuracy
Expert annotators provided regular feedback during annotation and conducted thorough post-annotation verification.
guideline: Annotators were asked to find a short span of answers (less than 10 words) from the Wikipedia page... and copy paste a short sentence from Wikipedia that contains the answer to the evidence section.
